data.action: 倚着浴缸边沿，湿发贴在肩头
data.camera: side view, medium shot, horizontal framing
data.description: 【蕾缪安 · 浴室的微光】弥漫着温热白汽的无障碍浴室里，蕾缪安赤身倚靠在浅底浴缸边缘，头顶的光环在水雾中泛着柔和的金色微光。湿透的长发贴在雪白的后背上，她向你伸出颤抖的指尖——「能麻烦你……抱我进水池里吗？只有在你的怀里，我才不会觉得自己是残缺的。」
data.promptProse: Lemuen reclines at the shallow accessible bath rim, reaching toward her off-frame companion for assistance. Her halo reflects gold on the water while steam veils the wall behind her.
data.title: 蕾缪安 · 浴室的微光
data.animaCaption: She reaches toward her offscreen companion for assistance from the shallow accessible bath rim.
